AR230
Fakes, Frauds and Mysteries
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
will explore popular, fantastic, and alternative interpretations of archaeological material presented in popular media. Archaeological myths and mysteries, often depicted as fantastic or cult archaeology, will be dispelled.
Students
will be encouraged to critically examine and analyze these pseudoscientific explanations.
